mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as growing economic output boosts corporate earnings expectations and market sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than a 5-year rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% triggers positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns, reflecting improved labor market conditions and reduced recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signal a dual expansionary monetary and demand-driven environment, amplifying equity valuations and 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.05% triggers positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns as market anticipates easing and lower interest rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05% in monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05% in tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns, reflecting robust manufacturing activity and investor optimism about economic growth.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1655 units triggers positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns, signaling strong demand and housing market recovery.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1655.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) amplify positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns, indicating a robust dual expansion in supply and demand.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite concurrent rises in INDPRO and GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as markets anticipate sustained labor market strength.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 5-day returns not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 5.0% in late-cycle expansion.
